features.title: Star of the show
features.text: Luminaries turn performance into occult magic, fighting with weapons and casting focus spells to help allies or hinder enemies.

features.title: Spotlight
features.text: Assign roles to friends and foes, then spotlight a creature to apply its role. Pass the spotlight as creatures target each other to keep the effects in play.

review.notes: Provisional assessment of the named playtest, not the final class. The public playtest period has ended; the published rules may differ.

ratings.offense: 2.5–3.5 → 2.5–3.5. Provisional playtest estimate: weapons and occult focus choices provide moderate direct offense.
ratings.defense: 3 → 3. Eight HP and martial defenses offer a reasonable baseline.
ratings.support: 4–5 → 4–5. Roles and spotlight effects emphasize enabling allies and hindering enemies.
ratings.utility: 3.5 → 3.5. Charisma and occult performance tools support social play.
ratings.difficulty: 4 → 4. Manage roles, spotlight transfers and focus resources; the playtest remains provisional.
